title: Vietnam veteran on shooting at spooks
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Vietnam veteran on shooting at spooks, about Vietnam War at Vietnam, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You think you shoot at somebody, you ain't shoot at nothing. Waste your fire out there. Guy in Vietnam told me that.

plain: Michael Johnson is an Air Force veteran who says he and others were taken by aliens decades ago. On Jesse Michels' podcast he repeated something a man who served in the Vietnam War once told him: when you think you are shooting at someone out there, you are not hitting anything, and you just waste your fire. He brings it up to suggest that what soldiers were shooting at may not have been ordinary people.
